name: How do I choose between custom and semi-custom cabinets for my kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between custom and semi-custom cabinets for my kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between custom and semi-custom cabinets depends on your budget, desired aesthetics, and specific functional needs. Custom cabinets offer unparalleled flexibility in size, material, finish, and features, allowing for a perfectly tailored kitchen unique to your home, often at a higher cost. Semi-custom cabinets offer a wider range of sizes and modifications than stock options, providing a good balance of personalization and value. Evaluate if standard sizing and available modifications meet your functional and design goals or if a truly bespoke solution is necessary.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose custom cabinets for unique design and exact fit; semi-custom offers more options than stock at a better value. The decision balances budget, aesthetics, and specific needs.
